verdict.rationale: Raygun docs confirm SDK-level filtering to strip sensitive data (e.g., credit card details) before it is sent, and an option to disable IP address storage, which addresses part of the scrubbing story. However, there is no evidence of server-side scrubbing rules applied after ingestion — the mechanism described is exclusively client-side/pre-send filtering. Missing for 10: documented server-side scrubbing/redaction rules, config UI for post-ingest PII rules, independent verification that sensitive payloads never persist.
